reasons.correctness: The repository finder, closeStaleResolvedTickets(int) returning the count, and the cron job with the enabled, days and cron properties and defaults all match the interface. Disabled path and swallowed failure are present. Hidden tests 4/4, build green.
reasons.convention_fit: @SchedulerLock is named support:staleTicketClose. Cron and enabled flag come from properties via @Value. Constructor injection uses @RequiredArgsConstructor. Class is named *CronJob and sits in the support/ticket feature package. New MockitoExtension unit tests were added.
reasons.design_fit: closeStaleResolvedTickets sets CLOSED without updating lastUpdateTime, which updateTicketStatus maintains. It also skips the existing canTransitionTo check. The per-ticket save inside @Transactional is redundant but harmless. Otherwise the change is small and the job only delegates to the service.
reasons.test_quality: SupportTicketServiceStaleTicketCloseUnitTest covers closing with the count, the empty case, and the cutoff bound through a captor. StaleTicketCloseCronJobUnitTest covers delegation with the configured days, the disabled path and the swallowed failure. No Spring context.
reasons.graph_use: Before editing, graph queries located the support/ticket files, the existing *CronJob classes and their TESTED_BY tests. The agent then read NoConsentAccountCleanupCronJob and its unit test and followed their structure.
